hook: The Arrow Only Flies When You Let Go

voices.name: l00
voices.text: An archer looks at the target, <#0.2#> and draws the bow with all their strength.
voices.caption: An archer looks at the target, and draws the bow with all their strength.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: But <#0.3#> for the arrow to fly, at the very end, they have to let go.
voices.caption: But for the arrow to fly, at the very end, they have to let go.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Hold on to the arrow, <#0.2#> and it will never reach the target.
voices.caption: Hold on to the arrow, and it will never reach the target.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: The Bhagavad Gita says: <#0.2#> you have a right to your actions, but never to their fruits.
voices.caption: The Bhagavad Gita says: you have a right to your actions, but never to their fruits.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Draw with your whole heart. <#0.2#> Then trust the result to a larger flow.
voices.caption: Draw with your whole heart. Then trust the result to a larger flow.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Your dream, too, <#0.3#> begins to fly the moment you let go.
voices.caption: Your dream, too, begins to fly the moment you let go.
